python-build-standalone build scripts: BSD-3-Clause; the libraries bundled in the runtime keep their own licenses (LICENSE files inside the runtime). Base packages: pypdf BSD-3-Clause, cryptography Apache-2.0 OR BSD-3-Clause, cffi MIT-0, pycparser BSD-3-Clause.
